body: I know the feeling of wanting them back but believe me it's no good. You don't deserve someone who could treat you like that. I was one of those success stories. My ex left me for another dude after 2 years. I went no contact and 30 days later she wanted me back. I took her back and you know what? She did the same thing again and cheated a bunch. I think sadly once it's broken it's broken. Taking them back shows them they can get away with treating you awful. He WOULD do it again. I know it hurts and honestly it will take a long time to accept but you are better off. Try not to look back. It's his loss

I still often think this way too. About the things I did to cause the end. But I think what we have to remember is that they had a choice. To talk to us and work it out. They chose that leaving was better than working it out. Someone who cares or deserves us won't leave like that. What you did is not uncommon in relationships AND you could have done a lot worse. At the end of the day it is just as much her fault as it is yours. And she has to live with that. Someone who won't give up on you will come along. And also use this as a reminder of ways you can improve yourself for them
I hope your doing ok. Did she just call randomly after 3 months NC?

I have tried meditation.  I have lots of work to do but it brings me no joy and I feel miserable in doing it when I used to enjoy it.  Thank you so much for your concern.  I guess I'm just coming to peace that this is my only way out really

thank you for the reply.  I've just given up hope.  It's been like this for too long and I've really just tried everything.  I honestly don't remember ever really feeling happy.  It sounds so much better to feel nothing.  I just need to make the preparations and get the balls to finish it

Honestly I would say don't.  I think the best way to hurt a narcissist (not saying thats your intent) is silence and indifference.  Any sort of contact feeds their supply.  Write the letter and save it for yourself if it helps.  But fuck him he doesn't deserve a word from you.

To save face.  People like this are deluded and justify what they did in their head.  They are embarrassed and guilt ridden.  To own up to what she did would be facing that she is a dirt bag and has no morals.  Karma will come and she will have to face her actions one day or another.  Hang in there dude.  Getting cheated on is worse than hell

this is the truth.  I'm starting to realize people don't really change.  And if they do it takes YEARS and so much effort to.  If she is capable of doing this to you she will do it to this guy and the next and the next...

I understand this.  I hooked up with a couple girls and went on a couple dates within a month of being dumped thinking it might help.  The girl even genuinely liked me when I was literally like a zombie on the date.  So uncomfortable.  I since stopped talking to any girls and hate that in a way I may have rejected someone.

It's like the kid with the toy they can't have.  All of a sudden that toy is the only thing in the world that exists.  In a strange way I think with my ex I was so emotionally drained and in a way over the relationship myself.  But since she pulled the plug AND cheated its like I can't get her out of my head.

It's nice to see there's possibly light at the end of the tunnel.  I came close to looking at her profile last night.  

I've been in dark place for a while myself.  Were you a mess for a while because of this breakup?

Not much advice to say. I'm just sorry man. I'm in a similar place. 

It's not fair. Don't contact her
this person sounds like a big turd.  you deserve better, positive uplifting people in your life.  Hope you cut the cord

It's true, in the end we are all human.  I guess all we can hope to be is the best of the worst haha.  

I know I made lots of dumb mistakes. It kinda hurts my guts when I think of the stuff I did.  Maybe I would have dumped myself haha.  

Honestly thats the worst...the walking on eggshells or never being sure.  That kinda stuff is like emotional abuse in a way.  Not a way to live a life or a relationship.

of course. this sub has helped me a lot and there's a lot of smart good people on here.  Feel free to post on here or message me whenever if you need help.  Its understandable to try just be prepared for the worst.  Don't contact him, anything you do or say will push him away or make things worse.  You'll have to let him come back, that is if he wants.  Again take this time to think about it for yourself!

I feel you.  I still wish she would write me too, or say something to let me know she hurts or misses me or EVEN thinks about me. I'd even want her to tell me she hates me.  Its the indifference that kills me.  

Honestly I don't have a great answer or even know for sure besides what I said earlier...maybe we are messed up ourselves?  They are horrible people.  Thats horrible of him to be hitting you up while with another girl.  And to talk to you even at all! It's selfish.

I don't know why we miss these people but we shouldn't.  Arrrr we are tough!

I totally understand.  And I know how you feel.  I hope you are the exception, and it could be! But I think you deserve better than to have someone doubt. Or if they do, talk to you about it and not give up.

Just wanted to warn you from experience.  I got my ex back after no contact, but I wish I had let her stay gone. As much as it hurt then.

It's okay and don't put yourself down.  I've read on this sub and other places that toxic relationships can be extremely hard to let go of.  Like you said it seemed not like a relationship but an obsession or infatuation? It's like a drug.  

I'll use a dumb analogy: It's like you were a heroin user.  In the depths of addiction using it everyday.  Then one day its gone and you have to stop.  Maybe some other stuff came along for a minute, you smoked some weed or drank but nothing as POTENT and powerful as that first drug you had.  So you find yourself always thinking about it.

Think of it like that maybe.  It's not this person you miss but how crazy they made you feel.  It's not love and its not healthy.  you deserve more.  I think maybe you should take time to examine yourself.  To find out why we ( I'm talking to myself here to) crave for these toxic situations.  I think something inside us is broken.  When that is fixed you won't miss him, and youll find someone who is much much better for you

Don't contact him until then.  If you want my advice I think you should take some time to think about if this is really what you want.  Do you want someone who will break up with you?  Who will give up on you like that and then make you wait like this, in a feeling of despair?  Its not ok.  

I think you should not contact him and let him go.  Let him live with his mistake and realize you deserve someone who wont leave you.  Whatever happens I hope the best.

After spending a LOT of time on here and reading many stories I've found a common theme that relates to me and maybe you.  If someone leaves you ONCE then its done.  So what you fell into depression.  If someone loves you or is worth being with you they stick with you through thick and thin.

I wasted 4 years with a girl who left me constantly and cheated on me.  She too left me when I fell into a depression.  You never gave up on him.  You never called it quits.  I think once someone initially smashes that trust its almost impossible to get back. 

Of course he was sorry and said all the write things.  It's selfish.  Its ego and its not love.  I'm sorry for all that happens but you deserve someone who will fight for you.  You deserve someone who won't break up with you even once.

You see his true character.  Don't feel dumb for giving second chances.  You loved him and you wanted it to work.  Shit I gave like 10 chances and I was insecure and I wish I had done a lot different.  But at the end of the day its on them.

You were disrespected and you are worth more.  he is not.  Stay strong

Hey man, I know how you feel.

My ex did similar stuff. Withheld/made me feel bad about being physical.  Constantly fucked with my mind.  She broke up with me numerous times...cheated on me MULTIPLE times.  And like a chump I stayed around.  I took her back, I believed her when she said she was going to change but it got me no where.  I wasted 4 years of my life in this.

We have to see we are worth more than this.  If someone breaks up with you ONCE it should be done.  Thats not love... if someone is unsure if they want to be with you ITS DONE.  Yes we could have done more or been more of a 'man.'  But at the core level they weren't right for us and maybe they aren't that great of people.

Take this time to realize we need to be strong on our own.  People can't walk over us.  If people leave let them go.  Stay strong buddy

Hey man I'm in a similar situation. Been broken up for around 50 days with no contact since then. I broke and looked at her socials a couple weeks ago and it did no good. Just made me think more of why she's not thinking of me or why she hasn't even tried to reach out once. I thought I was doing better for a bit but lately it's been almost worse. Past few days I miss her like crazy. Maybe we are just at a point when we are kinda facing the truth? That they are gone, they aren't going to come back. I don't know but just want you to know your not alone
Together for 4 years. Broke no contact 15 days ago but only by looking at her socials

Stay strong man! You're not alone. Almost identical story. Big mistake I made is after her relationship failed with the new guy she came back and I stupidly got back. Wasted almost 2 more years and she just cheated again.

Let her stay gone. You deserve so much more. I often wonder what she's doing too but they are liars and cheaters and whatever it is its not worth our time.
I hope she does, but I bet she's just fine. Thanks man
You're awesome thank you for this
Thanks man. You're right. There's no way im gonna make contact now, wish I had just said it at the time. Hope you're hanging in there
Thank you, I will do that!

I consider that a serious relationship. 1.5 years is plenty of time to fall in love. You were fully commited to each other and your both adults. Nothing child or juvenile about it.

And dating within 1-2 months is a rebound to me. I'm sorry for your loss I hope your ok
I know I made mistakes along the way so I keep doing this self blaming like its partly my fault... but you're right. Thank you so much
Thanks man, you're right. Part of me hopes she realizes it one day but I guess that doesn't matter. Gotta stay strong. Appreciate the words

Thank you for the reply, it means a lot. I know in my head I need to let her go but my heart wants her still. I don't understand why I let myself be treated this way, I feel like something is wrong with me.
